subject: Temporary manager coverage: approval & paperwork workflow
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: alex@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: temporary coverage for Platform Team

Hi team,

As discussed in last week's leadership sync, Alejandra will be on an extended leave starting 2027-04-10. I put together a short proposal for temporary manager coverage and the minimal paperwork HR needs to move the transfer through. High level: 

- Interim lead: promote Satish Kumar (IC) to temporary lead title for 8 weeks.
- Scope: Satish will own day-to-day 1:1s, sprint prioritization, and customer escalations; any promotion/compensation discussions stay with Ben + People Ops.
- Review cadence: weekly touchpoints with Ben + Jordan for first month, then biweekly.

Action items for this thread:
1) Ben/Jordan: confirm you approve the interim assignment and the proposed scope.
2) Olga: can People Ops trigger the short-form transfer paperwork and send the DocuSign to Satish + Alejandra?
3) I will prepare a 7-point handoff checklist and collect Q1 performance notes to attach.

Attachments: transfer_checklist.docx (draft), performance-notes_Q1.pdf (redacted highlights).

Target decision date: 2027-04-03 COB so we can announce before Alejandra's handoff week.

Thanks,

Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary coverage for Platform Team

Thanks Mina — looks sensible. A couple quick clarifications before I sign off:

- Duration: if Alejandra returns earlier, do we auto-revert the temporary title? (I assume yes.)
- Compensation: we should not change comp now; any promo talk is separate.
- Escalations: recommend we add an explicit escalation path to Ben -> Jordan -> CTO for high-severity incidents.

I approve Satish as interim lead contingent on HR paperwork and Satish's acceptance. Olga, please confirm paperwork timeline.

-Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

- DocuSign packet has been sent to Satish and Alejandra: https://docusign.com/sign/abc123-redwood

- Jordan: confirm on-call reassignment and add to the runbook.

If you want, I can schedule the DocuSign reminder for end of day tomorrow.
